detail.longDescription: I am self-hosting Coder on an Ubuntu 24.04 server using Docker Compose and Traefik. I am building a Terraform template to spin up sibling Docker containers for a Aspire (using .NET ) and Node.js environment. My goal is: Mount the host's /var/run/docker.sock into the workspace container so Aspire can manage its own sibling containers. Use mise via a coder_script to persistently install .NET 10 and Node.js into the user's /home/coder directory. However, when I start the workspace and open the web terminal, neither works: coder@workspace:~$ dotnet --version bash: dotnet: command not found coder@workspace:~$ docker ps failed to connect to the docker API at unix:///var/run/docker.sock; check if the path is correct and if the daemon is running: dial unix /var/run/docker.sock: connect: no such file or directory My Coder Server compose.yaml (snippet): services: coder: image: ghcr.io/coder/coder:latest group_add: - "988" # My host's docker GID volumes: - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock - /opt/docker/data/coder/home:/home/coder My Template main.tf (snippet): resource "coder_script" "install_tools" { agent_id = coder_agent.main.id run_on_start = true start_blocks_login = true script = <<-EOT #!/usr/bin/env bash set -e if [ ! -x "$HOME/.local/bin/mise" ]; then curl -fsSL https://mise.run | sh fi export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.local/share/mise/shims:$PATH" mise use -g dotnet@10.0 node@24 if ! grep -qs 'mise activate' "$HOME/.bashrc"; then echo 'eval "$(mise activate bash)"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc" fi EOT } resource "docker_container" "workspace" { count = data.coder_workspace.me.start_count image = "codercom/enterprise-base:ubuntu" name = "coder-${local.username}-${lower(data.coder_workspace.me.name)}" volumes { container_path = "/home/coder" volume_name = docker_volume.home_volume.name } volumes { container_path = "/var/run/docker.sock" host_path = "/var/run/docker.sock" } } Questions: Why is the socket throwing no such file or directory inside the docker_container workspace? Why are the mise installed tools not showing up? Reference: https://coder.com/docs/get-started/customize-your-template/install-command-line-tools#final-code
